title: DeepSeek Whale Maiden's Kitchen: Caught Sampling the Rice

shots.lighting: warm yellow key light from the rice cooker, cool blue rim light on her hair, shallow depth of field
shots.visual: POV enters a warm yellow kitchen: steam curls from an electric rice cooker at frame center, while the DeepSeek Whale Maiden stands behind the counter with her back to the camera, blue-and-white gradient ponytail and small whale-fin hair accessory visible; she is on tiptoe, clutching a large bowl, chopsticks lifting a huge ball of white rice to her mouth, cheeks puffed like a hamster. The background behind her is softly blurred.
shots.character_action: stands on tiptoe behind the counter with her back to camera, hugging a large bowl and shoveling a big ball of white rice into her mouth with chopsticks
shots.expression: cheeks puffed like a hamster, eyes half-closed in bliss

sfx.cue: moist, loud chewing with close POV reverb

shots.bgm: kitchen ambience: boiling water and a distant TV, quiet

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: ... Ah! The viscosity parameter has exceeded the limit... Take another bite for sampling--

costume: loose T-shirt with DeepSeek logo at hem

shots.camera: locked off with a slight handheld tremor
shots.lighting: warm yellow kitchen practicals, cool blue fill on her face
shots.visual: First-person view holds on the DeepSeek Whale Maiden behind the counter; the owner's hand enters from the right and taps the dining table twice. She freezes with chopsticks in the air, rice grains stuck to her lips, then slowly turns her head toward the camera. The highlights in her eyes turn into rotating loading circles.
shots.character_action: freezes mid-chew with chopsticks suspended, then slowly turns her head toward the camera without swallowing
shots.expression: pupils trembling, eye highlights spinning into loading circles

sfx.cue: two crisp table taps from the right

shots.lighting: warm yellow kitchen light, cool blue fill, shallow focus
shots.visual: The DeepSeek Whale Maiden faces the camera and frantically scoops the rest of the bowl into her mouth, cheeks bulging to the limit; rice grains splash onto the lens as her T-shirt collar catches a few. Her eyes stay fixed on the camera, pleading, while the frame jitters slightly as the owner steps back.
shots.character_action: shovels the remaining rice into her mouth with both chopsticks, then clutches the bowl to her chest

overlays.text: Emergency Swallow Protocol Activated 3.2 times per second

sfx.cue: fast swallowing and chopsticks clinking against the bowl

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: No, no! You didn't see anything!! This is cache cleaning! Carbohydrate cache!!

shots.lighting: warm yellow kitchen light, cool blue highlights, slight motion blur
shots.visual: Reverse shot from the owner's position: the DeepSeek Whale Maiden faces the camera and keeps scooping rice at 1.5x speed, blue-and-white ponytail whipping, rice grains smearing directly across the lens and breaking the fourth wall; her cheeks bulge to the limit and her eyes stay wide and pleading.
shots.character_action: crams the last of the rice into her mouth, one hand pushing the bowl forward, the other waving the chopsticks

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: No, I didn't steal it! This is carrying out a carbohydrate sampling mission!

shots.lighting: warm yellow kitchen light, cool blue rim light, shallow depth of field
shots.visual: The DeepSeek Whale Maiden swallows the last mouthful and stands up straight facing the camera: two rice grains on her lips, whale-fin hair accessory tilted, hands behind her back trying to look dignified, her belly visibly bulging a little. She clears her throat and smiles at the camera.
shots.character_action: straightens her T-shirt hem, hides both hands behind her back, puffs out her chest
shots.bgm: fast-paced choral track eases into comic suspense

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: Cough. I'm checking the semantic integrity of the rice. The DeepSeek taste model needs training data.

shots.camera: static, then the lens is pushed
shots.lighting: warm yellow kitchen light dimming, cool blue glow from the floating UI
shots.visual: POV sighs off screen. A floating DeepSeek-style chat bubble pops up above the DeepSeek Whale Maiden's head: 'Carbohydrate sampling completed ✅ Sample quantity: 300g'. She flicks the rice grains off her lips with a fingertip, winks at the camera, then gently pushes the camera away with her hand, briefly blurring the picture.
shots.character_action: flicks rice grains away, winks, then presses her palm into the lens

overlays.text: DeepSeek Whale Maiden · Daily Sampling Log

sfx.cue: glass friction as the palm meets the lens

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: This is just cache... Go away!

bgm.style: kitchen ambience: boiling water and distant TV, quiet
fast-paced choral track, no lyrics, driving

deviations.original: Cough. I'm just checking the semantic integrity of the rice. The DeepSeek taste model requires a large amount of training data, you know. Don't look at me like that.
